prs.location:
Griffith Wood’s location on the longest tree-lined avenue in the Northern Hemisphere is as suited for commuting to and from the city centre as it is for enjoying relaxed suburban living. 

Griffith Wood is located on the prestigious Griffith Avenue, Dublin 9. While quiet and peaceful, the community is a vibrant one that’s well populated by local shops, schools, parks and recreational sporting facilities. All of which are just minutes away and can be reached on foot. 

The complex is also close to Dublin City Centre, Dublin City University, Fairview Park, Croke Park, the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and East Point Business Park, and is well serviced by bus and cycle routes. The DART line in Clontarf is a short walk away, while Dublin City Airport and the M1 and M50 motorways can be easily accessed, allowing you to explore Dublin, the counties of Ireland and further afield.
prs.aboutDevelopment: Greystar is a world leader in property management services for rental housing communities globally. Operating in over 185 markets and over 500,000 multifamily units and student beds under management globally.

description:
Located on the prestigious Griffith Avenue in Dublin 9, Griffith Wood offers a purpose-built collection of Studios,1, 2 and 3-bedroom rental homes. With the finest urban facilities in a parkland setting, Griffith Wood is where city life meets suburban tranquillity to give you the best of both worlds.

Not only will residents benefit from a professional service, where all the homes are designed and furnished for modern living with high ceilings and large windows to increase natural light, they will also gain access to a community built around helping you enjoy a happy, healthy and productive lifestyle with concierge, gym and residents lounge. 

We provide a curated living experience for those looking to find new friends and neighbours, with our host of resident events throughout the year, all managed by a dedicated on-site team.

Griffith Wood offers unrivalled and well-designed amenity spaces with a concierge, private dining/ entertaining spaces, lounge areas, meeting rooms, a gym and yoga studio, a screening room and an expansive co-working space available for the enjoyment of our residents.

Griffith Wood's on-site co-working space is open 24/7 and equipped with super-fast WIFI and a coffee station. There's also parking, a secure bike storage and a postal room with secure parcel storage. All apartments are pet-friendly and residents can choose from furnished options in an array of floorplans, many with views of the tree canopy.

Interested in renting an apartment? Please email team@griffith-wood.com to speak to our team today.
